Pimpri-Chinchwad
HR professional focused on full-cycle Recruitment and Talent Acquisition with hands-on experience in Workday-driven HR operations and Onboarding. Notice period: 60 days.

Talent Acquisition Specialist, PhonePe — Oct 2024 - Present
Sourced, screened and closed candidates across engineering and product roles using data-driven outreach; improved offer-acceptance by optimizing messaging and follow-ups. Led end-to-end Recruitment processes for multiple hiring drives, coordinating interview panels and feedback loops. Managed candidate Onboarding workflows to ensure smooth first-week experience and completion of documentation. Collaborated with hiring managers to refine role profiles and hiring timelines, tracked hiring metrics in ATS and updated Confluence hiring playbooks.

HR Executive, CartNest — Jun 2023 - Sep 2024
Executed volume Recruitment for customer support and operations teams, reducing time-to-fill through targeted sourcing channels. Administered Workday-related HR transactions and maintained employee records. Ran Payroll processes including attendance reconciliation and statutory compliance, ensuring timely salary disbursal. Owned Onboarding programs for new hires, delivering orientation sessions and ensuring completion of pre-joining tasks. Documented HR processes and templates in Confluence.

HR Executive, Paystack India — May 2022 - May 2023
Managed end-to-end Recruitment for regional roles, coordinating interviews and candidate communications to meet hiring targets. Performed Workday data entry and maintained organisational HRIS accuracy. Processed Payroll inputs and liaised with finance for salary runs and deductions. Supported Onboarding activities, including offer letters, joining formalities and induction schedules. Updated Confluence with SOPs for HR operations.

Skills:
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Workday, Payroll, Onboarding, Confluence

Education:
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
